title: Meaning file, draft 2
description: A meaning file says what the data in a dataset means: concepts with labels per language, synonyms, a description, and bindings to ModelSpec record types and fields. Format meaning/draft-2: it may change before meaning/1. A concept is an entity, a property, a measure, a dimension or a value-set (a list of known values); bindings name a ModelSpec record type and field. Concept references are either a bare concept id (same repository) or meaning://{host}/{org}/{repo}/{concept-id}, optionally pinned with ?ref=<git-ref>. Rules that need more than one concept (extends joins compatible kinds only, of, values-of and units-of name entities or value sets, measure inputs and dimensions, ratios are never summed, binding roles match the model) are checked by tooling, not by this schema. The earlier format, meaning/draft-1, has its own schema, meaning.schema.json.

format.description: Format identifier and version. Every meaning file carries it.

id.description: Id of this file within its repository (for example a domain such as geo or a dataset such as chinook).

license.description: SPDX licence identifier of this file's content.

models.description: ModelSpec modules that bindings refer to: module short name -> path of its source, relative to this file.

sources.description: External datasets that concepts with a source come from.

fileId.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 80 characters.

conceptId.description: Starts with a letter; lowercase letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, each word starting with a letter; at most 80 characters. The camelCase form (drop each hyphen, capitalise the letter after it: billing-country -> billingCountry) is a valid record field id and never collides with another concept's.

valueId.description: Id of a known value: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (us, no, 840). A value id never changes meaning and is never deleted; a value that should no longer be used is marked retired.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag, language and optional region only (en, ru, pt-BR).

conceptRef.description: A bare concept id in the same repository, or meaning://{host}/{org}/{repo}/{concept-id}[?ref=<git-ref>].

modelRef.description: A ModelSpec record type: modelspec:///{module}.{Record} (same repository) or modelspec://{host}/{org}/{repo}/{module}.{Record}, optionally with ?ref=<git-ref>.

field.description: A field of that record type. Kept separate from the reference because modelspec:// fragments address enum values only. Written property in meaning/draft-1.

role.description: What the binding holds. instances (earlier name entity): the rows of the ModelSpec record type are instances of this concept (no field). identifier: the field is the record type's key. display-name: the field is the name people know an instance by. reference (earlier name foreign-key): the field is a reference to the record type whose rows are instances of this concept (or of the concept named by values-of). value: the field holds this concept's value. The earlier names are accepted and reported as a notice.

match.description: How stored values name the concept's known values (the values of the entity or value set named by values-of). labels (the default): a stored value equals a value's label or alias in any language, ignoring case. codes.<code>: a stored value equals the value's code of that name (codes.alpha2, codes.numeric). Only for roles value and display-name.

codes.description: Codes from external code lists, such as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

retired.description: True when the value should no longer be used. Its id stays, and a stored value that names it still matches (a notice, not an error).

formula.description: How the measure is computed, in words. Not an expression language.

aggregation.description: How values combine when grouped. A ratio (a measure with a measure among its inputs, or one that extends a ratio) is recomputed per group from its inputs: none.

inputs.description: Properties and measures it is computed from.

dimensions.description: Dimensions or properties it can be grouped by.

query.description: The saved query that computes this measure, when one exists.

dataset.description: The provider's own id for the dataset or indicator.

license.description: SPDX licence identifier of the source data.

of.description: The entity or value-set concept this one belongs to: a property, dimension or measure of it, or (for an entity) a part of it.

extends.description: Is a kind of: the concept this one specialises. Joins compatible kinds only (entity or value-set -> entity or value-set, measure -> measure, property or dimension -> property or dimension). Inherits synonyms (the parent's labels count as synonyms), unit, values-of and units-of when this concept has none of its own. Never inherits values.

values-of.description: The values of this property or dimension are instances of that entity or value-set concept (billing-country: values-of country). Its known values are that concept's values.

units-of.description: Amounts are expressed in a unit that is an instance of that entity or value-set concept (money-amount: units-of currency). The unit then names exactly one of that concept's values.

description.description: Plain English: what it is, and when to use it rather than a similar concept. Required: it is the record's Description or Meaning.

unit.description: Unit of the values. In words, or, when units-of applies, a label, alias or code of one value of that concept (USD).

values.description: The known values of a value-set, and only of a value-set. The list is open (the values known so far) unless complete is true.

complete.description: Only on a value-set: true when the list is all the values there are (the days of the week). A stored value that matches nothing is then an error; without it, it is reported as unknown.

source.description: Provenance: id of an entry in sources, when the data comes from outside the dataset. Allowed on any kind.
